description: CR 603.3d/701.3a whole cards: Sigarda's Aid equips the Piker it can target and nothing at all when the only creature has shroud
note: Sigarda's Aid: whenever an Equipment you control enters, you may attach it to target creature you control. The destination is a target chosen as the trigger goes on the stack (CR 603.3d), so alice's Goblin Piker is offered and, the may taken, wears the Bonesplitter as a 4/1. The -shroud twin swaps the Piker for a Blurred Mongoose. The trigger being on the stack with its target is the ChooseTargets prompt this run answers. The Bonesplitter being on the Piker is the +2/+0 it shows, the only one on the board.
